title: CueSheet routine file
description: A routine file for CueSheet: a JSON array of tracks, each authored musically (steps measured in 8-counts). Matches the Track[] shape validated by src/data/validateTracks.ts. Drop one in public/ and list it in public/routines.json to contribute.

id.description: Unique id for this routine (must be unique across the file).

steps.description: The ordered calling steps that make up the routine.

title.description: Optional title override (else fetched from Spotify).

artist.description: Optional artist override (else fetched from Spotify).

durationMs.description: Optional track duration in ms (else the live Spotify value is used).

firstBeatSec.description: Seconds into the track where count 1 lands.

bpm.description: Beats per minute. The usual range is 40–220.

wip.description: Mark the routine as a work in progress (suppresses the length warning).

_description.description: Free-text annotation (e.g. "Title — Artist"). JSON-only; ignored by the app.

^_.description: Underscore-prefixed keys are JSON-only annotations, ignored by the app.

step.description: The move/step the coach calls out, e.g. "Jumping Jacks".

cue.description: Optional detail or section label, e.g. "chorus", "arms up".

measures.description: Length of this step in measures (8-counts). Halves allowed.
